name: Stitt Solar
old_description: With the privilege of installing solar energy systems since 1978, we’re more than just a solar company — we’re educators and advocates for smarter energy choices. In an era of misinformation, we’re committed to providing clear, honest, and reliable information, backed by over 45 years of real-world experience. Our mission is to help you understand the true financial and environmental benefits of solar, so you can make confident, informed decisions for your home or business.
about:
Stitt Solar, based in Rogers, Arkansas, has been installing solar energy systems since 1978. The company began as a solar installer and has grown to serve residential and commercial customers across Northwest Arkansas and parts of Missouri.

The company provides end-to-end solar services including consultation and design, permitting, installation, and activation. It also offers battery storage solutions for off-grid homes, as well as inspection, repair, inverter installation, critter guard, and removal/reinstallation for roof replacement. Stitt Solar handles all city permits and utility paperwork, coordinating permission to operate.

Stitt Solar serves homeowners, businesses, and off-grid property owners in Arkansas cities such as Fayetteville, Bentonville, Rogers, and Springdale, and in Missouri communities including Branson and Nixa. Its customer base spans residential, commercial, and off-grid sectors.

The company distinguishes itself through an education-first approach, avoiding high-pressure sales and emphasizing clear, honest information. With over 45 years of experience, Stitt Solar positions itself as a trusted local installer that helps clients understand the financial and environmental benefits of solar.
